newsitem.title: UK: STATFJORD AUG LOADINGS DELAYED BY 2 DAYS - TRADE.
newsitem.headline: STATFJORD AUG LOADINGS DELAYED BY 2 DAYS - TRADE.

text.p: All August liftings of Norway's Statfjord crude have been deferred by two days because of production problems at the Snorre oil field, trade sources said on Tuesday.

"There will be a new Statfjord programme released this afternoon for the rest of August and everything will be deferred for two days," the source said, adding that one cargo would be pushed back into September.

The fields operator Den norske stats oljeseselskap AS (Statoil) had already adjusted the August programme in late July because of a long shutdown at Snorre and cut total liftings from 28 to 26 cargoes.
That total has now been cut to 25 cargoes after the 200,000 barrel per day Snorre platform suffered an unscheduled 36 hour stoppage that ended on Tuesday.
